title: Compound Tax
hook: Mama Tobi asks Chidi to carry one small bag of rice upstairs. He agrees — and the 'help' never stops.

scenes.speaker: Mama Tobi
scenes.dialogue: Chidi! Chidi! Come help me carry this rice upstairs nau. Just one bag.
scenes.sfx: Compound ambience — distant generator hum, chickens
scenes.image_keyword: Lagos compound veranda, Mama Tobi at doorway holding rice bag
scenes.text: Chidi! Chidi! Come help me carry this rice upstairs nau. Just one bag.

scenes.speaker: Brother Chidi
scenes.dialogue: Aunty Tobi, you know I no fit say no. Give me, I carry am fly.
scenes.image_keyword: Brother Chidi smiling, taking rice bag from Mama Tobi
scenes.text: Aunty Tobi, you know I no fit say no. Give me, I carry am fly.

scenes.speaker: Brother Chidi
scenes.dialogue: Ah, this bag heavy o. Na 'transport fare' I go take one cup from inside.
scenes.image_keyword: Chidi on stairs, scooping rice from torn bag into cup
scenes.text: Ah, this bag heavy o. Na 'transport fare' I go take one cup from inside.

scenes.speaker: Mama Tobi
scenes.dialogue: Chidi! You don open the bag? Na loading fee be that?
scenes.image_keyword: Mama Tobi hands on hips, watching Chidi descend
scenes.text: Chidi! You don open the bag? Na loading fee be that?

scenes.speaker: Brother Chidi
scenes.dialogue: Aunty, staircase tax separate. My knee dey pain me for this third floor.
scenes.image_keyword: Chidi rubbing knee, holding second cup of rice
scenes.text: Aunty, staircase tax separate. My knee dey pain me for this third floor.

scenes.speaker: Mama Tobi
scenes.dialogue: Wait, the rice don reduce like this? You say evaporation?
scenes.image_keyword: Mama Tobi peering into half-empty bag, confused
scenes.text: Wait, the rice don reduce like this? You say evaporation?

scenes.speaker: Brother Chidi
scenes.dialogue: Hot sun, steep stairs — evaporation real. But I fit help you recharge phone, save you wahala.
scenes.image_keyword: Chidi holding out hand for phone, sly grin
scenes.text: Hot sun, steep stairs — evaporation real. But I fit help you recharge phone, save you wahala.

scenes.speaker: Mama Tobi
scenes.dialogue: Hmm… okay o. Two thousand naira card dey my purse.
scenes.image_keyword: Mama Tobi handing recharge card to Chidi
scenes.text: Hmm… okay o. Two thousand naira card dey my purse.

scenes.speaker: Brother Chidi
scenes.dialogue: Network charge dey o. Five hundred naira enter my pocket for 'signal boosting'.
scenes.image_keyword: Chidi pocketing ₦500 note, typing on phone
scenes.text: Network charge dey o. Five hundred naira enter my pocket for 'signal boosting'.

scenes.speaker: Mama Tobi
scenes.dialogue: Chidi! My generator no gree start since morning. You fit check am?
scenes.image_keyword: Mama Tobi pointing to generator corner
scenes.text: Chidi! My generator no gree start since morning. You fit check am?

scenes.speaker: Brother Chidi
scenes.dialogue: Fuel surcharge apply. One litre from your jerrycan go solve am.
scenes.image_keyword: Chidi pouring fuel from Mama Tobi's jerrycan into generator
scenes.text: Fuel surcharge apply. One litre from your jerrycan go solve am.

scenes.speaker: Mama Tobi
scenes.dialogue: My son call from Canada! Chidi, help me pick am, my hand dey shake.
scenes.image_keyword: Mama Tobi thrusting phone at Chidi, anxious
scenes.text: My son call from Canada! Chidi, help me pick am, my hand dey shake.

scenes.speaker: Brother Chidi
scenes.dialogue: International connection fee. Your last suya piece don settle am.
scenes.image_keyword: Chidi eating suya wrapper, phone at ear
scenes.text: International connection fee. Your last suya piece don settle am.

scenes.speaker: Mama Tobi
scenes.dialogue: Chidi, you don collect rice, airtime, fuel, suya — all for 'help'?
scenes.image_keyword: Mama Tobi wide-eyed, Chidi wiping suya oil on shorts
scenes.text: Chidi, you don collect rice, airtime, fuel, suya — all for 'help'?

scenes.speaker: Brother Chidi
scenes.dialogue: Aunty Tobi, na Lagos we dey! Help no be free. *both burst out laughing*
scenes.image_keyword: Both laughing hard, Chidi slapping Mama Tobi's shoulder
scenes.text: Aunty Tobi, na Lagos we dey! Help no be free. *both burst out laughing*

caption: When 'help' comes with hidden taxes 😂 Compound life no get part two. Tag your own Brother Chidi!
